evidence_scope: Native Valentine matching optimization evidence. No labels, matcher formulas, defaults, thresholds or public APIs were changed.

methodology.timing: Fresh-process medians across 3 rounds, each 3 measured repetitions and 1 warmup. Runtime order rotates. Matching excludes loading, canonicalization, matcher construction, prior-result disposal, selection, fingerprinting and serialization. Native rechecks use 5 paired rounds and 21 repetitions.
methodology.memory: Linux lifetime process VmHWM, including setup, inputs, matching, output verification and report construction. Rust samples before final serialization; Python after prior checkpoint serialization. Child processes including CBC are excluded. wait4 peak RSS includes inherited pre-exec watermark and is retained separately. Neither measure is incremental matcher memory or total process-tree memory.
methodology.exact_native_identity: SHA-256 over ordered column pairs, IEEE-754 score bits and component-detail bits, plus filter(0.5), take_top_n(10), greedy(0.5), Hungarian(0.5), threshold-aware Hungarian(0.5) selections.
methodology.python_parity: Existing fixed Valentine 1.0 reference provenance, input and dtype checks, pair sets, declared absolute score tolerances (COMA and COMA instances 1e-6; Cupid, distribution, flooding and Jaccard 1e-10), and ranking checks. Exact native equality is separate from Python tolerance equivalence.
methodology.metadata: Original provenance retained once per batch. Runs use tables with named columns and rows in captured execution order. Per-run commands and redundant summaries/raw pair reports omitted; all recorded matching/warmup samples, RSS, fingerprints, loading/preparation/setup and process wall measurements retained.
methodology.aggregation: Per-side parity checks collapse only when all rounds have identical scalar checks/counts/errors. Otherwise every round check remains. Non-equivalent cases retain withheld speedups.
